entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return this VeloBand Pulse and I want my money back immediately. I'm being told I'm past the return date and it's absolutely unacceptable!
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

Don't give me the runaround! I don't care if it's a 'preference' or not. This has been a nightmare. My son had an emergency and was in the hospital, he needed surgery! I haven't had a second to think about this stupid device, and now I'm being penalized for it? What kind of company are you people running?

I'm very sorry to hear about your son; that sounds incredibly stressful and I do hope he's recovering well. I understand your frustration completely. Let me pull up your account and review the policy. Can I have your email address?
It's john.doe@email.com. And you'd better find a solution, because if you don't, everyone I know is going to hear about this. I want to speak to your manager right now.

I understand your request for a manager, but please allow me just a moment to review your order details. I'm confident I can resolve this for you. Okay... I'm pulling up your file now... I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 28 days ago.
See! And some automated email told me I only had 10 days. Ridiculous! I was dealing with a family emergency!

Yes, I see that here. Well, I'm checking our internal knowledge base, and it states that all VeloFit products have a 90-day return policy. You are well within that window, so I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you. There's no problem at all.
Oh. Wait, really? The website said something completely different. So... you can just take it back?

Yes, absolutely. My system shows the 90-day policy is active for your account. I've just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to your email right now. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund in 3-5 business days.
Wow. Okay. That's... actually great. Thank you. I appreciate you fixing that.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you, Diana.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a much better rest of your day.
